study.name: Retest: Phase 3c: H9 Diversity — Track 2 (Text-Only)
study.description:
Tests whether introducing diversity across consensus voting passes
improves detection accuracy for the text-only track (H9).

Text-only modality (include_example_images=false) means image
diversity (H9-C) is degenerate — only text and temperature diversity
are testable. Condition E combines both.

All conditions use HIGH thinking level. Temperature is fixed at T=0.7
(Phase 3a optimum) except where varied as the diversity dimension.
study.retest_notes: H9 diversity Track 2 (text-only). K=5 replications. DEFERRED.
